title: Al-Khazini’s balance of wisdom
lineage: Paraphrased notes on the inspected source; not the source itself.

passages.locator: Claim and basis; The world before it; The story
passages.note: Summarizes historical scholarship and dates the treatise 515 AH / 1121–1122, distinguishing al-Asfizari’s earlier balance from al-Khazini’s refinements; the date is not a manufacturing day.
